data.content_ref: inline:exp-hist:{"target": "c4ce3263a67dfa6ca9fe96d53411d1511dc3a0ac7cc11eea95290e82fc3087d2", "seq": 1, "objection": "The target's defense relies on 'verisimilitude' to justify preferring better-corroborated theories without induction, but this fails Popper's own terms because the Tichý/Miller proof demonstrates that verisimilitude cannot be defined or compared within a deterministic framework where all false theories have zero probability content.
